title: Irrational problem
statementMd:
Little Petya was given this problem for homework:

You are given function ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/22d161d4a5bc6cfd41667ca591d56973abfe8655.png) (here ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e91a39ad64cd7a33e8f1b67cd60e5b40257de950.png) represents the operation of taking the remainder). His task is to count the number of integers $*x*$ in range $[*a*;*b*]$ with property $*f*(*x*) = *x*$.

It is a pity that Petya forgot the order in which the remainders should be taken and wrote down only 4 numbers. Each of 24 possible orders of taking the remainder has equal probability of being chosen. For example, if Petya has numbers 1, 2, 3, 4 then he can take remainders in that order or first take remainder modulo 4, then modulo 2, 3, 1. There also are 22 other permutations of these numbers that represent orders in which remainder can be taken. In this problem 4 numbers wrote down by Petya will be pairwise distinct.

Now it is impossible for Petya to complete the task given by teacher but just for fun he decided to find the number of integers ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/66564024af56fb327f06ed6542f6badc5c851715.png) with property that probability that $*f*(*x*) = *x*$ is not less than $31.4159265352718281828459045%$. In other words, Petya will pick up the number $*x*$ if there exist at least $7$ permutations of numbers $*p*_{1}, *p*_{2}, *p*_{3}, *p*_{4}$, for which $*f*(*x*) = *x*$.

## Input

First line of the input will contain 6 integers, separated by spaces: $*p*_{1}, *p*_{2}, *p*_{3}, *p*_{4}, *a*, *b*$ ($1 ≤ *p*_{1}, *p*_{2}, *p*_{3}, *p*_{4} ≤ 1000, 0 ≤ *a* ≤ *b* ≤ 31415$).

It is guaranteed that numbers $*p*_{1}, *p*_{2}, *p*_{3}, *p*_{4}$ will be pairwise distinct.

## Output

Output the number of integers in the given range that have the given property.
statementZhMd:
小 Petya 的家庭作业是下面这道题：

给定函数 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/22d161d4a5bc6cfd41667ca591d56973abfe8655.png)（其中 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e91a39ad64cd7a33e8f1b67cd60e5b40257de950.png) 表示取余运算）。他的任务是统计区间 $[*a*;*b*]$ 中满足 $*f*(*x*) = *x*$ 的整数 $*x*$ 的数量。

遗憾的是，Petya 忘记了应该按照什么顺序进行取余，只记下了 4 个数字。对 4 个数字进行取余的 24 种可能顺序被选中的概率均相等。例如，如果 Petya 得到的数字是 1、2、3、4，那么他可以按照这个顺序进行取余，也可以先对 4 取余，再对 2、3、1 取余。这些数字的其他排列还可以表示另外 22 种取余顺序。在本题中，Petya 记下的 4 个数字两两不同。

现在 Petya 已经无法完成老师布置的任务，但出于兴趣，他决定统计区间中满足以下性质的整数 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/66564024af56fb327f06ed6542f6badc5c851715.png) 的数量：$*f*(*x*) = *x*$ 的概率不低于 $31.4159265352718281828459045\%$。换句话说，如果数字 $*p*_{1}, *p*_{2}, *p*_{3}, *p*_{4}$ 至少有 7 种排列使得 $*f*(*x*) = *x*$，Petya 就会选择数字 $*x*$。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含 6 个由空格分隔的整数：$*p*_{1}, *p*_{2}, *p*_{3}, *p*_{4}, *a*, *b*$（$1 ≤ *p*_{1}, *p*_{2}, *p*_{3}, *p*_{4} ≤ 1000, 0 ≤ *a* ≤ *b* ≤ 31415$）。

保证数字 $*p*_{1}, *p*_{2}, *p*_{3}, *p*_{4}$ 两两不同。

## 输出格式

输出给定区间内满足条件的整数数量。
